## Controller 1.0.51 (78)
- **Performance:** Threads write far less to disk. Streaming replies, tool output and many parallel subagents now save in fewer, larger batches, which is easier on your SSD and keeps busy sessions responsive. - **Performance:** Checkpoints and worktree lists no longer pause the app. Checking files for a checkpoint happens off the main thread, and worktree size scans are incremental, cancelable and limited in how many run at once. - **Fix:** Rolling back to a checkpoint could silently leave a newer version of a file in place if it was edited right after the checkpoint. Rollback now restores it reliably and leaves your staged changes alone. - **Agents:** Finished reports from many subagents reach their parent in one saved batch, and a report that could not be saved is retried instead of lost. - **Remote:** Sending from iPhone, iPad or Android while another send is in flight now joins it instead of failing.

## Controller 1.0.51 (77)
- **iPhone and iPad:** The model picker now uses the full height of its card. A sign-in or error status no longer floats mid-card, and the last model in the list scrolls fully into view instead of being cut off at the fold. - **iPhone and iPad:** Opening an active conversation now lands on its latest work and stays there as new output streams in, without taking back your scroll if you move away. - **Mac:** The New Thread palette keeps its focus when you reopen it, and focus returns to the composer when you close it. - **Android:** Sea Glass chrome is now a flat, sand-frosted sheet. Dark mode keeps its seafoam color, and secondary actions use an outline. - **Agents:** Threads coordinating across worktrees now send fewer, more useful messages, and they report status through their existing replies.

Built-in runtime for Cursor, Pi and Factory Droid, plus calmer connections, for Controller on Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android.
- Cursor: Controller now runs Cursor's SDK in its own built-in JavaScript runtime, and each Cursor chat runs in its own process, so a crash in one chat no longer stops your other Cursor chats. Download the Cursor SDK once from Settings → Harnesses; existing Cursor accounts show how until it is installed. - Pi and Factory Droid no longer need Node. If Pi is not already installed, Settings → Harnesses offers Download Pi. - Fixed Cursor and Pi chats occasionally failing to start with an "in use" message when another chat stopped at the same moment. - Connect: a Mac that stays unreachable is shown as offline and checked quietly in the background instead of reconnecting over and over. It is reached right away when it comes back, and sending work to it connects at once. - Connect: iPhones, iPads and Macs connected to a busy Mac no longer drop and reconnect every few seconds. - Connect: long conversations open faster on your other devices because their history is compressed.
Also includes the fixes prepared for build 75: messages are no longer refused after a brief problem saving the workspace, updates Controller finds start downloading reliably, and agents can install a Controller update when you ask them to.
